name: life-os
description: Life OS - Personal Intelligence Operating System (Tier 3: Agency Standard)

scripts.sidecar:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn src.api.main:app --host localhost --port 8765 --reload
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others --kill-others-on-fail --names 'SIDECAR,TAURI,MOBILE' --prefix-colors 'blue,green,magenta' "pnpm run sidecar:dev" "pnpm run dev:mobile" "cd apps/desktop && pnpm tauri:dev"
